items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Bob Robinson, Joe Waddle, and Edward J. Powers, the sax wizard. [INTERVIEWEE] Yep.

ctx.x: I think that's Joe Mitchell, if I'm not mistaken. He played Gana. And he also played Sticks. Marimba. Marimba. Marimba.
Bob Robinson, Joe Waddle, and Edward J. Powers, the sax wizard.
